name: File Manager
description: Ephemeral file management interface with tree view, search, and file operations. Integrates with FileEditorCell for bidirectional editing.

_discovery.describe: File management utility for browsing, uploading, downloading, and organizing project files. Provides tree view of directory structure with file operations (create, delete, rename, move). Supports drag-and-drop upload and bulk operations. Integrates with local filesystem or cloud storage. Fast directory listing (~500ms for typical folders). Useful for managing assets, scripts, and configuration files. Includes file search and filtering capabilities.
